title.english: A Place to Come Back To

pairs.target: dìèrtiān zǎochén , jiǎn lǎoshī de zhuōshàng pū zhe yìzhāng gānjìng zhǐ , nài lěi dàilái de dìtú què zhǐnéng xié fàng .
pairs.english: The next morning, Instructor Jian’s desk bore a clean sheet, but the map Nerai brought would only fit diagonally.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天早晨，简老师的桌上铺着一张干净纸，奈蕾带来的地图却只能斜放。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ zìjǐ de bēizi nuó dào chuāngtái , wèn zhèhuí háiyào buyào liú gè zhǐyìn .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey moved her own cup to the windowsill and asked whether it was necessary to leave another fingerprint this time.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把自己的杯子挪到窗台，问这回还要不要留个指印。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng chū tā zài shuō xiānqián nàcì mò zhǐyìn , rěn zhe méi xiào , děng nài lěi zuò wěn , biàn bǎ zuótiān tán guò de huó shuō le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi heard her referring to the earlier ink fingerprint, held himself back and did not laugh; once Nerai was seated, he went over the work discussed yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听出她在说先前那次墨指印，忍着没笑，等奈蕾坐稳，便把昨天谈过的活说了一遍。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán , jiǎn lǎoshī méiyǒu xiān wèn yào jiāo duōshǎo yè , zhǐ bǎ bǐ fàngxià , wèn tā ruò yùdào méi kàn dǒng de dìfāng , zhǔnbèi zěnme huílái jiǎng .
pairs.english: After he finished, Instructor Jian did not first ask how many pages were required; he simply set down his pen and asked him how he planned to report back if he encountered something he did not understand.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完，简老师没有先问要交多少页，只把笔放下，问他若遇到没看懂的地方，准备怎么回来讲。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zhào yuányàng dài huílái , néng wèn de xiān wèn , bù míngbái de liú zhe , bùnéng děng nài lěi tì zìjǐ shuō dǒng le .
pairs.english: Tavi said he would bring it back as it was, ask what he could, leave what he did not understand unresolved, and not wait for Nerai to claim understanding on his behalf.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说照原样带回来，能问的先问，不明白的留着，不能等奈蕾替自己说懂了。

pairs.target: nài lěi kào zài yǐbèi shàng , méiyǒu tì tā tiān yíjù .
pairs.english: Nerai leaned back in her chair without adding a word for him.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾靠在椅背上，没有替他添一句。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī tīng wán , bǎ tā shàngcì liànxí de jìlù dìguòlái , jiào tā kàn zuìhòu nà yìháng .
pairs.english: After listening, Instructor Vey passed over his last practice record and asked him to read the final line.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师听完，把他上次练习的记录递过来，叫他看最后那一行。

pairs.target: nàlǐ xiě zhe huīfù dúshù , xiàmiàn cái shì xièzài , tā kànjiàn zìjǐ de zì , shǒuzhǐ biàn zài zhuōxià qīngqīng dòng le yíxià .
pairs.english: It said restoration of readings, with unloading beneath it; seeing his own writing, he then flexed his fingers lightly under the desk.
pairs.hanzi: 那里写着恢复读数，下面才是卸载，他看见自己的字，手指便在桌下轻轻动了一下。

pairs.target: " zhè tàoliào liúzài guì lǐ . "
pairs.english: “This set of materials stays in the cabinet.”
pairs.hanzi: “这套料留在柜里。”

pairs.target: tā shuōhuà hěn duǎn , yòu wèn tā yàoshi lùshang yǒurén tīngshuō tā shì xuégōng chūlái de , ná gè shēngxiù jiāzi qǐng tā bāngmáng ne .
pairs.english: She spoke briefly, then asked what he would do if someone on the road heard he came from the academy and handed him a rusty clamp, asking for help.
pairs.hanzi: 她说话很短，又问他要是路上有人听说他是学宫出来的，拿个生锈夹子请他帮忙呢。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō kěyǐ dì dōngxī , kěyǐ zhǎo huì xiū de rén , bùnéng yīnwèi biérén zháojí , jiù bǎ méi hé guò de dōngxī àn zài shǒuxià .
pairs.english: Tavi said he could pass objects and find someone who knew repairs, but could not put unverified objects under his hands merely because others were in a hurry.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说可以递东西，可以找会修的人，不能因为别人着急，就把没核过的东西按在手下。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , bǎ zhǐ fàng huí zìjǐ nàbiān , méiyǒu ràng tā zài bèi yíbiàn .
pairs.english: She nodded and drew the paper back to her side without making him recite it again.
pairs.hanzi: 她点头，把纸放回自己那边，没有让他再背一遍。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhè cái bǎ yìfēng gāng dào de duǎnxìn tānkāi , shuō chuánjiā jīn zǎo shāo láihuí huà , liùtiān hòu zài chì píng zhuāng yán , néng liú liǎnggè rén de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Nerai then unfolded a freshly arrived note and said the boatman had sent a reply that morning: they would load salt at Red Flats in six days and could keep room for two people.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾这才把一封刚到的短信摊开，说船家今早捎来回话，六天后在赤坪装盐，能留两个人的位置。

pairs.target: tā dǎsuàn sāntiān hòu chū chéng , yán nánpō yìlù zǒu liǎngrì , dìsānrì shàngwǔ dào chì píng , xiān liú bàntiān wèn àn lù de xiāoxī .
pairs.english: She planned to leave town in three days, walk two days along the south-slope post road, and reach Red Flats on the third morning, leaving half a day to ask for news about the bank path.
pairs.hanzi: 她打算三天后出城，沿南坡驿路走两日，第三日上午到赤坪，先留半天问岸路的消息。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī wèn ruò yán chuán bù zǒu ne .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian asked what if the salt boat did not sail.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师问若盐船不走呢。

pairs.target: " liúzài chì píng , xiān zuò nàlǐ de jìlù , gǎi xíngchéng jiù sòngxìn , bú zìjǐ qù zhǎo tiáo méi wèn guò de chàlù zhuī chuán . "
pairs.english: “Stay in Red Flats and make the records there first; send word if the itinerary changes, rather than chasing the boat down an unasked-about side route ourselves.”
pairs.hanzi: “留在赤坪，先做那里的记录，改行程就送信，不自己去找条没问过的岔路追船。”

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ liǎnggè yántú dài xìn chù quān chūlái , shuōmíng nǎ yíchù zhǐshì zhuǎnjiāo , nǎ yíchù yǒurén huì qīnshǒu sòngdào xuégōng .
pairs.english: Nerai circled two message points along the way, explaining which merely forwarded mail and which had someone who would deliver it to the academy in person.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把两个沿途带信处圈出来，说明哪一处只是转交，哪一处有人会亲手送到学宫。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi náchū zìjǐ de lùxiàn liànxí zhǐ , gēn tā nà zhāng duì zhe kàn , zhǐ shàng nàgēn quēkǒu zhùzi hūrán bù xiǎnde kěxiào le .
pairs.english: Tavi took out his route exercise and compared it with hers; suddenly the chipped post on the paper no longer looked ridiculous.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿出自己的路线练习纸，跟她那张对着看，纸上那根缺口柱子忽然不显得可笑了。

pairs.target: tā wèn ruò rén bú zài , xìn néng bunéng fàngxià , wèn wán cái fāxiànzìjǐ búshì zài děng lǎoshī chūtí .
pairs.english: He asked whether he could leave the letter if the person was absent; only after asking did he realize he had not been waiting for the teacher to set a question.
pairs.hanzi: 他问若人不在，信能不能放下，问完才发现自己不是在等老师出题。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō bùnéng dàngzuò yǐjīng jiāodào shǒulǐ , jiǎn lǎoshī biàn ràng tā bǎ zhè jù yě xiě zài pángbiān .
pairs.english: Nerai said that could not count as delivery into someone's hands, and Instructor Jian asked him to write that beside it too.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说不能当作已经交到手里，简老师便让他把这句也写在旁边。

pairs.target: tāmen méiyǒu wèi měi yìzhǒng huàitiānqì lìng huà yìtiáo lù , zhǐ bǎ yuán lù fǎnhuí de dìfāng shuō qīng , cuòguò de xiāoxī zhàoshí jì .
pairs.english: They did not draw a separate route for every kind of bad weather, only clarified where they would turn back on the original route and record missed messages honestly.
pairs.hanzi: 他们没有为每一种坏天气另画一条路，只把原路返回的地方说清，错过的消息照实记。

pairs.target: gōngqián xiě zài lìng bànzhāng zhǐ shàng , měitiān shíèrwén , cóng chū chéng suàn dào huíchéng , lùshang děng chuán yě suàn , chī zhù hé lùfèi lìngfù .
pairs.english: The wage went on the other half-sheet: twelve coppers a day, counted from leaving town to returning, including days waiting for boats; meals, lodging and fares were paid separately.
pairs.hanzi: 工钱写在另半张纸上，每天十二文，从出城算到回城，路上等船也算，吃住和路费另付。

pairs.target: huídào xuégōng liǎngrì nèi jiéqīng , ruò túzhōng yào xiān yòngqián , kěyǐ xiān lǐng yíbùfen .
pairs.english: It would be settled within two days of returning to the academy; if he needed to spend money along the way, he could draw part of it in advance.
pairs.hanzi: 回到学宫两日内结清，若途中要先用钱，可以先领一部分。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú dào zhèlǐ táitóu , nài lěi shuō búshì yào tā chuāizhe kōng kǒudài qù zhuāng dàfāng , chuánshàng yě yǒu xiǎng zìjǐ mǎi de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Tavi looked up at this; Nerai said he need not go with empty pockets to play the generous man, since there might be things aboard he wanted to buy for himself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读到这里抬头，奈蕾说不是要他揣着空口袋去装大方，船上也有想自己买的东西。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī shuō xuégōng zhèbiān zhàocháng bǎoliú zhùchù , cuòguò de liǎngcì xiǎozǔ liànxí huílái bǔ , bù bǎ yántú xiě de zì zhíjiē dǐng chéng liànxí chéngjì .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian said the academy would keep his room as usual; the two missed group exercises would be made up afterward, and writing along the way would not directly count as practice grades.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师说学宫这边照常保留住处，错过的两次小组练习回来补，不把沿途写的字直接顶成练习成绩。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhòu le xià méi , shuō ruò huíchéng wǎn liǎngtiān , yě bié jiào tā yíxià chuán jiù bǔ .
pairs.english: Nerai frowned and said that if the return was two days late, they should not make him catch up the moment he stepped off the boat.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾皱了下眉，说若回程晚两天，也别叫他一下船就补。

alignment.english: the moment he stepped off the boat

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jiēguò huà , shuō tā huì kàn rén zài pái , jiào nài lěi bié gé zhe yìzhāng zhuōzi tì tā xiōng xuéshēng .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey interjected that she would assess him before scheduling, and told Nerai not to scold students on her behalf from across a table.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师接过话，说她会看人再排，叫奈蕾别隔着一张桌子替她凶学生。

pairs.target: sāngè rén gèzì xiào le yíxià , tǎ wéi què hái dīng zhe nà háng zhùchù bǎoliú .
pairs.english: The three of them each laughed a little, but Tavi was still staring at the line about keeping his room.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人各自笑了一下，塔维却还盯着那行住处保留。

pairs.target: tā xiānqián méi xiǎng guò zìjǐ huì pà huílái shí méiyǒu dìfāng , xiànzài kànjiàn zhè jǐgè zì , cái zhīdào zìjǐ yǐjīng xiǎng guò .
pairs.english: He had never before thought of himself as being afraid of having no place when he returned; now, seeing these few words, he finally realized he had already thought about it.
pairs.hanzi: 他先前没想过自己会怕回来时没有地方，现在看见这几个字，才知道自己已经想过。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī bǎ zhǐ zhuǎnxiàng tā , shuō zhè tàng tóngyì le , rènwu jiùshì jìlù , nài lěi quánchéng dài zhe , biàndòng réng àn gāngcái shuō de lái .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian turned the paper toward him and said the trip was approved: the task was recording, Nerai would accompany him throughout, and changes would follow the procedure they had just agreed.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师把纸转向他，说这趟同意了，任务就是记录，奈蕾全程带着，变动仍按刚才说的来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yìng le yìshēng , gé le huìer , yòu wèn néng bunéng xiànzài gàosù jiālǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi answered, then after a pause asked whether he could tell his family now.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维应了一声，隔了会儿，又问能不能现在告诉家里。

pairs.target: " xiànzài jiù néng . "
pairs.english: “You can right now.”
pairs.hanzi: “现在就能。”

pairs.target: lǎoshī bǎ yìzhī kōng xìnfēng fàngzài zhuōbiān , méiyǒu cuī tā dāngchǎng xiě , zhǐ wèn zhǐ gòubugòu .
pairs.english: The teacher set an empty envelope beside the desk without pressing him to write on the spot, only asking whether he had enough paper.
pairs.hanzi: 老师把一只空信封放在桌边，没有催他当场写，只问纸够不够。

pairs.target: nài lěi shōu tú shí , bǎ zuótiān jiè de hòuchē péng cǎotú huángěi tā , shuō zìjǐ yǐjīng lìng miáo le jìhào , pángbiān xiě le shì shuí huà de .
pairs.english: As she packed the maps, Nerai returned yesterday's borrowed shelter sketch, saying she had traced the marks separately and written the artist's name beside them.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾收图时，把昨天借的候车棚草图还给他，说自己已经另描了记号，旁边写了是谁画的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tānkāi kàn , zhǐbiān háishì zìjǐ de jiù zhéhén , méiyǒu duōchū yídào xīnxiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi opened it to check; the edge still bore his old fold, without one extra new line.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摊开看，纸边还是自己的旧折痕，没有多出一道新线。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tā fàng huí zhǐdài , gāng zhàn qǐlái , wéi lǎoshī jiù zhǐzhǐ chuāngtái , wèn shì shuí bǎ tā de bēizi là zài nàlǐ le .
pairs.english: He put it back into the paper bag; just as he stood up, Instructor Vey pointed at the windowsill and asked who had left her cup there.
pairs.hanzi: 他把它放回纸袋，刚站起来，维老师就指指窗台，问是谁把她的杯子落在那里了。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō bān bēizi de míngmíng shì tā zìjǐ , tǎ wéi zhōngyú méi rěnzhù , xiào de bǎ xìnfēng yě dǒu le yíxià .
pairs.english: Nerai said it was clearly she herself who had moved the cup; Tavi finally could not contain himself and laughed until he shook the envelope too.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说搬杯子的明明是她自己，塔维终于没忍住，笑得把信封也抖了一下。
